evaluation_cases.text: Growth: Cells were maintained in plates of BG-11 and grown in constant light and constant 30ºC, under ~40µE of illumination with fluorescent lights. Treatment: Prior to collection, cells were grown in plates containing solid BG-11 media for different amounts of LD cycles, being exposed to either short (LD8:16; 8h of light, 16h of darkness) or long (LD16:8) days. Existing reviewed qualifier: constant30ºC is stated for growth/maintenance; not explicitly restated for the LD-cycle treatment phase.
RNA-seq cultures were maintained at30°C throughout the LD treatment and harvested at30°C.
Stocks were maintained at30°C; later temperature for the treated cultures was not reported.
Cells were exposed to 8h light and16h dark; temperature was not stated.
All experimental cultures, including RNA-seq cultures, were grown at30°C unless stated otherwise. No RNA-seq exception is stated.
